name: Bruce Whitehead
summary: A powerfully built Fury FC regular with knockout power, taking a UFC debut on about nine days' notice, a week after a 48-second TKO; knocked out quickly by Victor Valenzuela in 2025.

how_they_fight.Striking: Power puncher; best work against weak opposition (Sherdog).
how_they_fight.Defense: Quick KO loss raises firefight concerns.

sources.title: UFC 332 fight card adds undefeated welterweight on short notice
